messages.author: b4ce8db4b948fdbd
messages.subject: Suggestion: geom_feather() and/or geom_quiver()
parts:
I was wondering if there were any plans to program a new geom for feather (example) or quiver (example) plots? I was trying to implement something like this using the geom_segment(), but calculating the segment endpoints proves challenging. I'm guessing there would be quite a lot of interest among ggplot2 users, and may be an 'easy' spin-off from geom_segment().

Just a thought...

Kevin
